name: Separator / Content Section
description: Content Section product scenario for the Separator component.

controls.name: orientation
controls.description: Draws a horizontal line across the available width, or a vertical line down the height of its row and at least one control tall.

controls.name: decorative
controls.description: Hides the line from assistive technology; `false` exposes it as a separator with its orientation, for a break between sections or a resize handle.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Insets the line by the control spacing on every side, so its ends line up with the visible edges of neighbouring controls.
